source.license_status: Original game data; no open asset license found. Wiki identity checks do not grant a license to original game assets.

source_format: orderedmap/ability/ability_soul.json is the original numeric equipment rule table, not a downloaded animation DSL.

ability_soul.active_block_policy: Decode only blocks selected by c2; inactive columns remain raw, never executable fallback content.
ability_soul.strength_units: Only reviewed ratio operations divide their original strength by 100000. Unknown commands keep raw strings and no invented units.

equipment_enhancement_ability.policy: Retained unmodified; its column layout is distinct from 123-column equipment rules.

field_mapping.enum_region_warning: CN instant trigger codes are not JP-compatible; no full CN enum table is applied to JP data.

semantic_review_policy.context: Only these exact complete 123-column rows are semantically reviewed; an opcode is never sufficient to admit another row.
semantic_review_policy.original_progression: For reviewed equipment, choose the highest unlocked original level per slot; original levels are not project backpack ranks.
semantic_review_policy.during_namespace: The reviewed Pierce entries use during trigger c94=30 and during content c106=0; these are not instant event/effect enum numbers.
semantic_review_policy.enhancement: All 108 enhancement rows remain unsupported; each full 126-column row is fingerprinted without being translated.
semantic_review_policy.runtime: Semantic decoding does not grant an equipment item, waive an original condition or claim any gameplay implementation.
